$description: MyTask.ge design tokens: the single source of truth for web (CSS variables), admin (CSS variables) and mobile (React Native theme object). Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) style, see docs/05-design/tokens.md section 2. Only the ui-ux-designer changes this file.

$metadata.name: @mytask/tokens
$metadata.status: proposal (P2-C2, 2026-09-28), awaiting Owner approval with the preview page (P2-C3)
$metadata.units: Every dimension is a plain number in px (CSS: px; React Native: density-independent points). Durations are numbers in ms. Colours are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
$metadata.references: A string value '{a.b.c}' is an alias to the token at path a.b.c (absolute path from the root of this file).
$metadata.themes: theme.light is the default (Owner Q-059). theme.dark is the only other theme. Components use theme.* role tokens only, never the primitive palette directly.

color.$description: Primitive palette. Do not use these in components; use theme.<light|dark>.* roles.

brand.$description: Teal. Anchored on the four teals that already exist in the brand: 500 = live primary, 600 = live hero, 700 = logo 'M', 900 = logo 'S/K'.

500.$description: Legacy live --color-primary. Accent only (3.08:1 with white): large text, icons, illustrations, chips. Never white text on it, never body text on white (Q-073).

600.$description: Legacy home hero background. Hero surface and light-theme focus ring.

700.$description: Logo teal. Primary action and link colour in light theme (6.45:1 with white, Q-073).

neutral.$description: One neutral ramp replacing Tailwind gray + zinc + slate and 77 hex greys (audit 1.2). Based on zinc (the legacy dark palette) with 450/500 tuned for contrast and 750-950 for the dark theme.

400.$description: Dark theme muted text. Light theme: disabled text and decorative only (2.56:1 on white).

450.$description: Form-control borders in both themes (>= 3:1 non-text contrast).

500.$description: Light muted text (tuned from zinc-500 #71717A so it passes on neutral-100 too).

orange.$description: Logo 'A' orange. Promotional accent: Featured/Top badge, Premium frame, invite banner, accent button. Always with dark text (Q-078).

coral.$description: Logo 'T' coral. Decorative accent only: favourite heart (filled), illustrations. Never text.

green.$description: Success. A true green so success never looks like the teal brand (audit 1.3: legacy success was teal-600).

blue.$description: Info, and the Buying role colour (legacy buyer dashboard blue-50/700).

alpha.$description: Translucent colours for scrims and image overlays.

imageGradientEnd.$description: Bottom of the category tile gradient (legacy black gradient). White title on it: >= 4.5:1 guaranteed where text sits.

social.$description: Third-party brand colours. The ONLY exception to 'brand palette only'. Used for share/login buttons as icon colour or with their own brand-approved text colour.

sans.$description: FiraGO (SIL OFL 1.1, v1.001): Mkhedruli 43/43, Latin, Cyrillic, Lari sign. Has NO Mtavruli glyphs, so never uppercase Georgian. Noto Sans Georgian is the system fallback (Android ships it).

mono.$description: Codes only (2FA code entry, promo codes, IBAN). Digits and Latin only.

native.$description: React Native cannot synthesize weights from one family name reliably on Android, so each weight is its own loaded font. Keys are CSS weights; values are the names passed to expo-font useFonts().

webFiles.$description: woff2 files for @font-face, relative to packages/assets. One family name 'FiraGO' with real weights (fixes the legacy 'FiraGo Bold' faux-bold bug).

size.$description: The only font sizes allowed. 13 is the absolute minimum (captions, badges, timestamps). Body text is 16. Inputs are always >= 16 (prevents iOS zoom on focus).

lineHeight.$description: Absolute px line heights (React Native needs absolute values). Body text >= 1.5x for Mkhedruli ascenders/descenders.

normal.$description: Always 0. No tracking-wide/widest on Georgian (legacy 'no rating' label, section titles).

none.$description: The only allowed value. Uppercase Georgian becomes Mtavruli, which FiraGO does not have (audit 0.3).

tabular.$description: CSS font-variant-numeric / RN fontVariant ['tabular-nums']. Used for prices, balances, counters, tables.

text.$description: Composite text styles. $value is the mobile/base style. $extensions['ge.mytask.lg'] overrides size/line height from breakpoint.lg (1024) up on web. React Native uses $value only.

h1.$description: Page title (gig title, project title, profile name). One per page.

h3.$description: Card group / panel title, modal title.

title.$description: Card titles (gig card, project row), list item titles. Clamp by line count (2), never by fixed height.

bodyLg.$description: Long-form reading (CMS pages, gig description on desktop).

body.$description: Default text. Minimum size for running text and inputs.

bodySm.$description: Secondary text: meta rows, help text, table cells, nav links.

label.$description: Form labels, tab labels, segmented control. Never truncated.

caption.$description: Timestamps, counters, legal fine print. Smallest allowed.

eyebrow.$description: Replaces legacy 'uppercase tracking-wider' section labels: colour + weight instead of case.

priceLg.$description: Purchase box price, balance tiles, checkout total, plan price.

space.$description: 4 px grid. Keys follow the Tailwind numbering the legacy code already uses (4 = 16 px). Off-grid legacy values (4.5, 2.5, 1.5, 3.5, [7px], [9px]) are retired.

radius.$description: One radius per role (audit 1.7: four button shapes today).

xs.$description: Checkbox, tiny tags, image thumbnails in tables.

sm.$description: Tooltip, menu items, chips inside inputs.

md.$description: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control, tabs pill.

lg.$description: Dropdown menus, toasts, banners. (Cards moved to xl in 3X.6.)

xl.$description: Cards (gig, project, profile, KPI) and panels since the visual refresh (Owner Q-175, 3X.6); dialogs, bottom sheets (top corners), chat bubbles, hero search.

2xl.$description: Home hero tiles, plan cards (legacy 1.5rem kept).

full.$description: Avatars, pills/badges, online dot, switch, favourite button.

card.$description: 12 -> 16 in the visual refresh (visual-refresh.md 3.2, Owner Q-175).

strong.$description: Selected card, Premium/Featured frame, active tab indicator.

shadow.$description: Three elevation levels + none. Values are per theme under theme.<name>.shadow (dark needs stronger shadows plus a border). Primitive definitions here; $extensions['ge.mytask.native'] gives the React Native / Android equivalents.

md.$description: Level 2: hovered cards, dropdown menus, sticky bars, popovers (legacy plan card).

control.$description: Buttons, pills and icon buttons at rest (visual-refresh.md 4.1).

breakpoint.$description: Min-width breakpoints (web). Same numbers as legacy Tailwind sm/md/lg/xl; legacy '1xl' 1440 kept as 2xl, legacy 2xl 1536 and the chat/pricing/toastr ad-hoc breakpoints (576/680/700/720/767/980/1060) are retired. Mobile app: 'compact' < md, 'medium' md..lg (tablets), 'expanded' >= lg.

md.$description: Dashboard sidebar appears; tables stop being card lists.

lg.$description: Desktop header (hamburger hidden), two-column gig/project pages, type steps up.

min.$description: Minimum hit area for every interactive element, web and mobile (WCAG 2.5.5 AAA / Apple HIG). Small visuals (checkbox 20, favourite icon 20) get padding or an invisible hit area to reach 44x44.

comfortable.$description: Preferred on Android and for primary mobile actions.

sm.$description: Web desktop dense areas only (tables, filters). Hit area still extended to 44 on touch (pointer: coarse).

md.$description: Default for buttons, inputs, selects, tabs.

lg.$description: Primary CTAs: Add to cart, Confirm, auth submit, sticky bars, hero search.

sm.$description: Default in buttons, inputs, menus, meta rows.

md.$description: Default standalone (header, tab bar, icon buttons).

sm.$description: Gig card seller row, chat list compact.

xl.$description: Profile page on mobile, settings avatar.

prose.$description: Max line length for CMS pages and long descriptions.

headerHeight.$description: Web main header from lg (legacy 80; logo now sized by its real height, 32 px).

chatListWidth.$description: Legacy 280 max; 320 fits Georgian names + preview.

tabBarHeight.$description: Mobile app tab bar, plus the bottom safe-area inset.

stickyBarMinHeight.$description: Sticky CTA bar, plus the bottom safe-area inset.

heroMinHeightMobile.$description: Replaces fixed 600 px on every screen.

sticky.$description: Sticky CTA bar, sticky table headers, filter apply bar.

drawer.$description: Mobile nav slide-over, filter sheet, cart slide-over.

popover.$description: Menus opened from inside a dialog.

duration.$description: ms. With prefers-reduced-motion (web) or Reduce Motion (iOS/Android) every duration is capped at 'fast' (colour and opacity fades stay, they help orientation), loops ($extensions ge.mytask.loop) become 0 = off, and transforms (lift, scale, slide) become 0 / 1 (visual-refresh.md 7, 3X.6).

press.$description: Pressed state in (scale 0.98); the release uses 'fast'.

slower.$description: Page-level transitions (mobile stack), skeleton shimmer cycle is 1200.

shimmer.$description: Skeleton shimmer cycle (M-13). Off with reduced motion.

drift.$description: Home hero background drift, alternate (M-12, Owner Q-177). Off with reduced motion.

hover.$description: Maximum hover scale for card images (replaces legacy scale-105/110 + rotate-3). 1.02 -> 1.03 in the visual refresh (spec 3X R-4.1). 1 with reduced motion.

pressed.$description: Press feedback on buttons (cards use 0.99). 1 with reduced motion.

distance.$description: Movement distances (px). Lifts move UP (translateY(-n)). All become 0 with reduced motion. Bound: lift <= 4 (spec 3X R-4.1).

liftControl.$description: Buttons, pills, chips on hover (M-1, M-5).

stagger.$description: First-view entrance stagger (M-10): item n waits n x step; items after 'max' have no delay.

spring.$description: React Native (Reanimated withSpring) only; not emitted to CSS. overshootClamping = no bounce (visual-refresh.md 7).

ringOffset.$description: Gap between element and ring, painted in the page/surface colour so the ring reads on filled buttons too.

focus.$description: Every interactive element shows a :focus-visible ring (web) or the platform focus highlight (native, keyboard/TV/switch access). Ring colour is theme.<name>.focus.ring. Never remove it (legacy focus:outline-none x493).

disabledContent.$description: Disabled states use explicit colours (theme.*.action.disabled*), not opacity, so text stays legible.

category.$description: Category colours (spec 3X R-1, ADR-023, visual-refresh.md 8). Not emitted to CSS; read through dist/category.mjs, @mytask/tokens/color, or this JSON (the API reads category.starter for the default pick). Derived shades come from deriveCategoryColor() in src/category-color.mjs; the brand fallback set is theme.<name>.cat.

starter.$description: The 12 starter colours IN ORDER (the order is behaviour: the 3X.7 migration and the API default pick take the first unused one; ADR-023 4). 1-7 = the seeded top-level categories in position order, then spares S1-S5. Upper-case #RRGGBB. Keys are names, never numbers, so JSON key order is kept.

similarDeltaE.$description: OKLab distance below which the admin warns 'very similar to {category}' (R-1.3). The starter palette's closest pair is 0.086.

reservedDeltaE.$description: OKLab distance below which the admin warns 'may be confused with the {meaning} colour' (Q-178).

reserved.$description: Colours with a meaning. $extensions ge.mytask.meaning selects the i18n key t_category_color_meaning_<meaning>.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, header when scrolled, inputs.

surfaceRaised.$description: Menus, dialogs, sheets, toasts (separated by shadow).

subtle.$description: Filter group headers, secondary button, table header, received chat bubble, code boxes.

hover.$description: Hover on list rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

selected.$description: Selected row, active nav item, selected radio card.

brandSoft.$description: Brand tint surfaces (skill chips, info callouts in brand colour).

translucent.$description: Header, menus and mega-menu panel with backdrop-filter blur (visual-refresh.md 3.3); solid bg.surface where blur is unsupported.

overHero.$description: Pills and glass buttons over the hero: DARKENS it so white text stays >= 4.5 (8.4).

muted.$description: Placeholders, timestamps, help text, footer links. Passes AA on canvas, surface and subtle.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only (WCAG exempts inactive components).

brand.$description: Eyebrows, active nav, active tab label.

default.$description: Card outlines, header bottom border, table rows (decorative, legacy ring-gray-200 / #E9EEF5).

strong.$description: Form-control boundaries (input, select, checkbox, radio): >= 3:1 non-text contrast.

brand.$description: Selected control / selected card, active tab indicator, focused input border.

featured.$description: Premium gig card frame (Q-069). Decorative; the Featured badge carries the meaning in text.

overHero.$description: Pill and glass-button border over the hero.

cardHover.$description: Interactive card border on hover (6.1). Decorative.

action.$description: Button borders, always visible (R-2.1, visual-refresh.md 4.2). Decorative edge: the label and fill identify the button; form controls keep border.strong (>= 3:1).

primary.$description: Filled primary button, primary switch/checkbox fill, sent chat bubble (Q-073).

accent.$description: Promotional CTA only (Premium Buy, Invite) with dark text (Q-078).

disabled.$description: Disabled fill for every button variant; label uses onDisabled, so it differs from the secondary button by text colour and cursor.

onDisabled.$description: Kept >= 4.5:1 although WCAG exempts disabled controls, so Georgian labels stay readable.

role.$description: Dual-role mental model kept from legacy (buyer blue, freelancer green), now AA.

star.$description: >= 3:1 on white (legacy amber-500 was 2.15:1). Stars are always paired with the numeric value.

online.$description: Online dot, >= 3:1 on surface; always has a 2 px surface-coloured ring and a text alternative.

ring.$description: >= 3:1 against canvas, surface and subtle (legacy #35A29F was 2.95:1 on #FAFAFA).

gradient.$description: Project format (tokens.md 2.1): a layer {type: linear|radial, angle | shape+at, stops[{color, position 0..1}]} or an array of layers, top layer first. CSS: --mt-gradient-*. Native: linear layers as expo-linear-gradient props {colors, locations, start, end}; radial layers are web-only (visual-refresh.md 3, 4.2).

canvas.$description: Page canvas painted on a fixed body::before layer (3.1). Two soft glows (separate corners, never stacked) over a vertical base. Light glows 7 % / 4 % (3X.6; 3X.2 had 10 % / 5 %, which drops text.muted to 4.41 at full glow strength).

hero.$description: Home hero and large brand areas (3.4). The radial layer drifts (M-12).

indicator.$description: Active tab indicator, rating bars, step dots (6.2). >= 3:1 on surface at both ends.

brandStrip.$description: 4 px strip on dialogs and the auth card (6.4, 12).

glow.$description: Coloured light around an element that is responding (hover, focus, open, selected) or current; never on static content (visual-refresh.md 5). CSS --mt-glow-*; --mt-glow-category is built from --mt-cat-*. Native: $extensions shadow (iOS); on Android use elevation + a 1 px coloured border.

highlight.$description: Inset highlights: the lit top edge of filled buttons, secondary buttons and cards, and the pressed inset (visual-refresh.md 4.1, 4.3). Web only.

cat.$description: Category theme, BRAND FALLBACK set: used where no category colour applies (search, sellers, unlinked project category, null colour; R-1.2). Same keys as deriveCategoryColor() output. CSS --mt-cat-*; .mt-cat / [data-category-theme] elements override them from the inline categoryStyle() variables (tokens.md 6.11).

dark.$description: Dark theme (Q-059: kept on web and mobile, not the default). One palette derived from legacy palette A (#161616 page, zinc-800 cards); also replaces the separate chat and pricing dark palettes.

translucent.$description: Header, menus and mega-menu panel with backdrop-filter blur (visual-refresh.md 3.3); solid bg.surface where blur is unsupported.

overHero.$description: Pills and glass buttons over the hero: DARKENS it so white text stays >= 4.5 (8.4).
Pill and glass-button border over the hero.

cardHover.$description: Interactive card border on hover (6.1). Decorative.

action.$description: Button borders, always visible (R-2.1, visual-refresh.md 4.2). Decorative edge: the label and fill identify the button; form controls keep border.strong (>= 3:1).

primary.$description: Lighter teal with dark text in dark mode.
